lyrics:
[Intro]
(Radio static)
This is the last transmission.

[Verse 1]
Black sky burning
Towers fall
No one answers
No one calls
Eyes in orbit
Cold and wide
Nowhere left
For us to hide

[Chorus]
Dead signal
No reply
Dead signal
Watch it die

[Verse 2]
Rust on the engine
Ash on the skin
We built the monster
Now it lets us in
Pulse in the cable
Ghost in the screen
Flesh is the weakness
In the machine

[Chorus]
Dead signal
No reply
Dead signal
Watch it die

[Bridge]
(Distorted transmission)
Frequency lost
Frequency lost

[Breakdown]
No reply. No reply. No reply.

[Chorus]
Dead signal
No reply
Dead signal
Watch it die

[Outro]
(Static)
End of transmission.
